Marshalls.ai_overview_text:
Marshalls allows full refunds to the original payment method for in-store purchases returned within 30 days with a valid register receipt.
In-Store Purchases
- Within 30 days with receipt: Full refund to your original payment method.
- After 30 days, or with a gift receipt / no receipt: Issued as a merchandise credit card. Without a receipt, a valid government-issued ID and personal info are required.
- Condition: Items must be unwashed, unused, and appropriately tagged. Swimwear and intimate apparel must have original tickets attached.
- Holiday Return Policy: Purchases made between October 4, 2026, and December 24, 2026, can be returned through February 4, 2027 (for online) or extended holiday windows in-store.
Online Purchases

Home Depot.ai_overview_text:
The Home Depot allows returns for most new merchandise within 90 days with proof of purchase.
Standard Return Windows
- 90 Days: General merchandise, most plants, and standard items.
- 365 Days: Purchases made with a Home Depot consumer credit card, Pro Xtra credit card, or commercial account (does not override shorter item-specific windows).
- 30 Days: Furniture, consumer electronics, gas equipment, paint sprayers, and seasonal holiday decor (such as Halloween and Christmas items, which must be unused and have a receipt).
- 7 Days: Air conditioners, dehumidifiers, gas generators, pumps, portable evaporation products, and portable heaters (must be unused with proof of purchase).

Adidas.ai_overview_text:
The standard Adidas return policy allows you to return online or in-store purchases within 30 days of receipt for a full refund, provided items are in good condition with original tags and packaging.
Key Rules & Timelines
- Standard Return Window: 30 days for most online and in-store orders.
- Hype / Limited Items: Must be returned within 14 days.
- Holiday Return Policy: Online orders placed between October 29, 2026, and January 11, 2027, have an extended return window of 60 days.
- Condition: Items must be unworn, in original packaging, with all apparel tags and shoe boxes intact.
Non-Returnable Items

Dick's Sporting Goods.ai_overview_text:
Review the Dick's Sporting Goods Return Policy for standard timeframes, rules, and item exceptions:
- 90-Day Policy: Most products purchased at Dick's Sporting Goods, Calia, VRST, and Golf Galaxy can be returned within 90 days from the date of purchase (in-store) or from the original shipment date (online orders).
- Condition: Items must be clean, unused, and in resalable condition with all original packaging and tags.
- Proof of Purchase: Valid proof includes a sales receipt, order confirmation email, order number, pack slip, or return barcode.
Shorter Return Timeframes & Special Rules
- 30-Day Policy: Applies to Dick's Sporting Goods Warehouse and Going, Going, Gone! locations, as well as fitness equipment, firearms, ammunition, and opened Theragun or Hyperice recovery products.
- 7-Day Policy: Pre-owned, demo, refurbished items, and Nike Adapt shoes have a 7-day window and are eligible for exchange only.
- 24-Hour Policy (Bikes): Bicycles have a 24-hour size/color verification window. Unused bikes can be returned within 24 hours of purchase or pickup only if they have not been ridden/used and retain all original tags.
Non-Returnable & Restricted Items
- Baseball/Softball Bats: Eligible for return only if they are unused.
- Factory Sealed Items: Returns may be denied if factory seals are broken on items like football helmets, air beds, e-bikes, or electronic scooters.
Returns Without a Receipt
- Returns without a valid proof of purchase require a valid government-issued ID.
- Refunds are issued as a store credit for the item's system-generated lowest selling price.
If you'd like, let me know:
- What specific item you are trying to return
- How long ago you bought it
- Whether you have a receipt or online order number
I can give you the exact steps or help you figure out if it qualifies for a refund!

Ulta.ai_overview_text:
Ulta Beauty allows returns of new and gently used products within 30 days of purchase for a full refund with proof of purchase, and between 31 and 60 days for merchandise/store credit.
Key Return Guidelines
- Return Window:
  - 0–30 days: Full refund to your original payment method with a receipt or Ultamate Rewards lookup.
  - 31–60 days: Merchandise or store credit.
  - After 60 days: Returns are generally not accepted.
